note: Element definitions live in data, not code. Adding an element means editing this file (spec 3.2). Ids are declared here and are permanent: they are baked into saves and world hashes, so reordering this list must never change behaviour. Id 0 is reserved for empty space.
valueNote: `value` is what a cell is worth to a collector, in points, and is absent for everything a collector should not reward — feeding one unwashed sand destroys it for nothing. `currency` marks the element those points are pressed into: a collector never eats currency, and what a collector is holding is the player's balance.

elements.note: Currency, and matter like everything else. A collector presses product into nuggets; a nugget only counts as money while a machine is holding it (spec 5.1). Denser than anything else here, because it is gold.
elements.name: gold

reactions.note: Spec 5.3's worked example. Both cells become product, so a reaction changes composition without changing how many cells hold matter.
